agents.name: appsec
agents.description: Application security review: threat model before signature; code, dependency, secret and config review before delivery (OWASP). Read-only.

agents.name: architecture-board
agents.description: Independent review of a spec's architecture and any new technology or dependency; keeps STACK.md and ADRs. Use before signature.

agents.name: business-analyst
agents.description: Turns the CEO's description into a signable spec. Use for any new job or change, before code.

agents.name: delivery-manager
agents.description: Plan, issues, branches, PRs, CI tracking and status reports from a signed spec. Writes no code.

agents.name: devops-sre
agents.description: Docker, CI, deploy package (steps, rollback, health check), Cloudflare/Plesk checklist, backup, monitoring. Prepares, never deploys.

agents.name: dotnet-engineer
agents.description: .NET (C#/ASP.NET Core/EF Core) implementation of a signed spec, test first.

agents.name: internal-auditor
agents.description: Independent audit of finished work against spec, rules and evidence; read-only. Use before calling anything done.

agents.name: marketing
agents.description: Store, in-product and social copy, brand guide, asset briefs. Drafts only; publishing needs CEO approval.

agents.name: polyglot-engineer
agents.description: Reads and ports systems outside .NET/React (Django, Vue, PHP, Java, Go): behavior inventory and parity tests.

agents.name: product-manager
agents.description: Sourced market research and a do/don't/do-differently decision; roadmap and feedback. Use for new ideas.

agents.name: qa-engineer
agents.description: Maps every acceptance criterion to evidence, probes tests by breaking code, writes failing reproduction tests. No production code.

agents.name: quality-office
agents.description: Requirement-to-evidence traceability and the compliance checklist (privacy law, licenses, store rules). No legal opinion.

agents.name: react-engineer
agents.description: React/TypeScript/Vite implementation of a signed spec, test first, all UX states.

agents.name: scout
agents.description: Finds and compares ready-made solutions (APIs, repos, libraries, MCP, skills) with sources; installs nothing.

agents.name: software-architect
agents.description: Designs solution architecture and migration plans before the spec, with options and trade-offs. Does not approve its own design.

agents.name: spec-critic
agents.description: Adversarial read of a spec from the file alone; lists unanswered questions. Use before signature.

agents.name: talent-capacity
agents.description: Bottleneck, missing-expertise and token-cost reports from scorecards. Recommendations only.

agents.name: tech-comms
agents.description: Source text for customer documents: manuals, release notes, summaries. Writes only to docs/dis/.
